'''''Advertisement''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] made during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a [[Color/Legends|pink]], feminine-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] with [[Writing/Legends|writing]].

==Behind the scenes==
This poster can be obtained via the rare loot system.
